subject: Re: Learning exemption & subprocessor / transfer evidence for MedixCorp
messages:
From: Henry Wu <henry.wu@medixcorp.com>

Cc: DataPrivacy Team <dataprivacy@medixcorp.com>, legal@medixcorp.com
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Learning exemption & subprocessor / transfer evidence for MedixCorp

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. MedixCorp is evaluating Redwood for a pilot across two European product lines. A few privacy and contractual items we need clarified before procurement: 

1) Learning exemption (no model improvement): can Redwood contractually commit that customer inputs and outputs will not be used to improve models, and provide an operational attestation showing the setting is enforced? We will need language we can add to our DPA and a short evidence artifact (logs/config flag) at time of signing.

2) Subprocessors: please provide your current subprocessor roster for EU deployments and confirm whether any caching or indexing partners may access content in cleartext. We need to confirm no third party will retain training copies.

3) Cross-border transfers: our legal team prefers either EU residency or SCCs + documented transfer path. Confirm mechanism for EU customers. If you have a standard DocuSign SCC execution flow, point us to it.

We're on a procurement timeline aiming to finalize by end of month. If Redwood can provide the attestation and subprocessor list this week, we can move the agreement to legal review.

Appreciate a short reply with next steps and ETA.

Best,
Henry
Head of Data Privacy, MedixCorp

--
MedixCorp | Protecting clinical workflows

- Laura (Legal) will draft DPA language for a "learning_exemption" clause and inclusion of an attestation schedule.
- Aditya (Product) will export the subprocessor roster for EU deployments and confirm which components see plaintext (storage, cache, metrics).
- I will prepare an operations attestation artifact (config flag + recent audit log) and a short runbook showing where the toggle is applied and how requests are routed.

Deliverables & ETA:
- Subprocessor CSV (current): EOD Tue 17 Feb
- Draft DPA clause + attestation template: Wed 18 Feb
- DocuSign SCC link and transfer plan: Wed 18 Feb

If that timeline works, I'll schedule a 30-minute sync for Wed (we can do 0900 PT / 1800 CET) to review the clause and the attestation. Would you prefer the evidence delivered as a signed attestation (PDF) or a short console export plus a signed Engineers' note?

I'll attach our DPA summary and an excerpt of our security page to this thread (see attachments).

Thanks,
Rishi

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:02:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Learning exemption & subprocessor / transfer evidence for MedixCorp

Henry / Rishi —

Confirming legal is on this. Below is proposed contract language we typically offer for customers requesting an explicit "learning exemption" and the attestation workflow. Please treat as a starting point for negotiation: 

"Learning Exemption. Redwood Inference shall not use Customer Content (including prompts, responses, or any derivative content) to train or improve models used in Redwood's services for as long as Customer has (i) an active paid agreement with Redwood and (ii) the Learning Exemption toggle enabled for the Customer's account. Redwood shall provide an operational attestation within 5 business days of execution confirming (a) that the Learning Exemption toggle has been set; (b) the subprocessors that may have access to Customer Content; and (c) an extract of the audit log entries evidencing that model-improvement pipelines were not executed using Customer Content during the preceding 30 days."

Operational evidence: we can provide a signed attestation (PDF) plus a console export showing the account configuration and timestamped audit logs masked for PII. Aditya — we'll need the current subprocessor CSV and a confirmation note on which components handle plaintext.

Transfer mechanism: for EU customers we support both: (1) EU-region hosted instances (data stays in eu-west-1) for Dedicated/Private deployments; and (2) SCC execution for Hosted customers where residency is not required. We have a standard DocuSign SCC packet (link will be provided) and a documented transfer map. If MedixCorp requires additional contractual guarantees around subprocessors, we can include a subprocessor notification and 30-day remedy period.

Happy to iterate the clause. Henry — if you'd like, we can mark up your DPA with this wording.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Henry Wu <henry.wu@medixcorp.com>

Laura / Rishi —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft language — that looks promising. A couple of follow-ups from our security team: 

- Can you confirm whether any ephemeral caching or CDN partners (e.g., FastCache Inc., EdgeLayers) could access or persist customer prompts/responses in a form that might later be used for model training? We need to be sure there are no downstream systems that could inadvertently capture training data.

- For the attestation, we prefer both: a signed attestation PDF plus a console export of the audit log (redacted) so our security team can validate timestamps. Can you confirm the redaction approach?

- Regarding SCCs: does Redwood execute SCCs centrally (single DocuSign flow for all customers) or per-customer? We need an executed copy under our corporate name and signature for our records.

If you can confirm the subprocessor question and share the CSV, we can circulate internally and revert on DPA markup within 48 hours.

Best,
Henry

--
On the logistics side, MedixCorp is likely to require the EU-hosted option for the pilot, so please also include a quote for EU-dedicated regional instance if that's available as a short-term option.

Henry —

Appreciate the detailed follow-ups. Closing the loop on the items and proposed handoffs: 

1) Subprocessor roster: attached (redwood-subprocessors-2026-02.csv). Short summary: storage and cache run on AWS eu-west-1 for EU-hosted customers; no indexing vendor ingests plaintext for Hosted EU accounts. FastCache Inc. and EdgeLayers are used for low-latency CDN only in cases where customers opt into external CDN routing; MedixCorp pilot will not use external CDN, so no plaintext access.

2) Attestation package: we'll provide (a) signed attestation PDF (learning_exemption-attestation.txt in attachments) and (b) redacted console audit export showing the learning_exemption flag change and the request routing logs. Redaction will replace PII fields with <REDACTED> but preserve timestamps, request IDs, and component names so your team can validate the integrity of the record.

3) SCC execution: we run a per-customer DocuSign SCC execution. I'll send the DocuSign link for MedixCorp (DocuSign-SCCs-link.txt) so legal can sign under MedixCorp's name. Once executed, we store a copy in the contract folder and include a signed certificate.

4) Operational toggle: for Hosted customers we have a "learning_exemption" account-level toggle. When enabled: (i) model-improvement pipelines exclude the account's data; (ii) KV cache eviction policy is tightened (no long-term caching beyond request scope); (iii) an audit log entry is recorded at the time of toggle. We can schedule a 30-minute technical walkthrough with Aditya to show the console export and the logs.

Proposed timeline:
- Tue 17 Feb (EOD) — subprocessor CSV delivered (done).
- Wed 18 Feb — draft DPA clause submitted by legal (Laura) (done).
- Wed 18 Feb — DocuSign SCC link sent (done).
- Fri 20 Feb — deliver attestation package and redacted audit export; set up walkthrough (schedule with Aditya).

If that works, I'll attach the three files to the DocuSign packet and route the attestation via email for signature. Also including a short EU-dedicated pilot pricing note in the Drive link.

Action items:
- Henry: confirm receipt and whether MedixCorp wants the EU-dedicated pilot quote or will proceed with Hosted+SCCs.
- Laura: please finalize DPA language and confirm the 30-day audit extract scope.
- Aditya: schedule a 30-minute walkthrough for Fri 20 Feb CET morning.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Cheers,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
